name: local-ifc-viewer
description: Offline IFC viewer and material lists for Windows
author: IFC Viewer

scripts.build: npm run assets && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.test:materials: tsc src/material-data.ts --target es2022 --module es2022 --moduleResolution bundler --outDir .cache --skipLibCheck && node scripts/test-materials.mjs
scripts.test:display: tsc src/display-state.ts src/material-data.ts --target es2022 --module es2022 --moduleResolution bundler --outDir .cache --skipLibCheck && node scripts/test-display.mjs
scripts.test:grids: tsc src/grid-visibility.ts --target es2022 --module es2022 --moduleResolution bundler --outDir .cache --skipLibCheck && node scripts/test-grid-visibility.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:materials && npm run test:display && npm run test:grids
